title: Measuring SERCA-mediated calcium uptake in mouse muscle homogenates
protocol: Set plate reader to 37°C.
Shake Ca2+ uptake buffer.
Vortex muscle homogenate.
Add 200 μL of Ca2+ uptake buffer to black Eppendorf tubes.
Add 20 μL of muscle homogenate to the tubes.
Add 1 μL of Indo-1 (2 mM) to the tubes.
Vortex reaction mixture.
Plate 100 μL of reaction mixture in duplicate into an all-black 96-well plate.
Read plate using excitation wavelength of 355 nm and dual emission at 405 nm and 485 nm.
Remove plate from plate reader.
Add 4 μL of 250 mM ATP to each well.
Read the plate kinetically using the same excitation and emission settings.
Shake the plate continuously or at intervals during the reading process.
Perform readings for 30 min with intervals of 20 s.
Add 10 μL of 50 mM EGTA to each well after the initial read to obtain a "minimum" value.
Read the plate again after adding EGTA in increments until values stabilize.
Add 80 μL of 100 mM Ca²⁺ solution to each well following EGTA addition.
Read the plate again to obtain a "maximum" value for calibration.
Mix 1 μL of 40 mM cyclopiazonic acid stock with DMSO.
Add the mixture to each well.
Continue the kinetic plate read for an additional 10–15 minutes or until a plateau is reached.
